rows.proof: The town’s debt service BY YEAR, FY2023 to FY2047, off the GRAND TOTAL block of the FY2022 debt repayment schedule. THE BLOCK IS ON PAGES 46 AND 48, NEITHER OF WHICH WAS IN THE PAGE TRACKER AT ALL -- the tracker lists a page only when recognition found fifteen money figures on it, and these two carry five rows each. The whole of the town’s forward debt service was invisible for that reason. Two identities per year and both close: principal plus interest is GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL & INTEREST, and that plus the MWPAT admin fees is TOTAL DEBT. All five rows sum across the 25 years to the TOTAL column printed on p48 -- 38,749,085 principal, 14,765,895 interest, 12,764 admin fees, 53,527,743 total debt. AND IT RECONCILES TO THE FOURTEEN INDIVIDUAL BORROWINGS on pages 45 and 47, read separately and filed beside this. THE PAGE PRINTS DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS OVER AMOUNTS THAT CARRY CENTS, so a printed total is the ROUNDED SUM and not the sum of the rounded parts. What says that rather than a misread: every column with no cents beneath it ties EXACTLY -- all fourteen issues’ PRINCIPAL except the four Mass Water Pool loans, and the interest on GOB SCH OF 2014, GOB MPL OF 2017, DPW-ROADS GOB PML OF 2018 and both municipal purpose issues. Everything that misses is a MWPAT loan or a fractional-cent amortisation, and it misses by $1 to $8 across up to 25 displayed values, where the arithmetic bound is $12.50.

rows.reconciliation: 20 of 20 rows carry exactly 8 figures; grade runs in order through all 160 rows
rows.proof: The Salary Administration Plan schedule for FY2023, Article 21 of the 7 May 2022 annual town meeting, printed on page 152 -- 20 grades against STEP 1 to STEP 8, 160 HOURLY rates. Read with page_table.py off the page’s own text layer, so the characters are exact. THIS PAGE PRINTS NO TOTAL ANYWHERE and there is no arithmetic on it to close, so the check is COVERAGE, declared and asserted on every run: 20 grade rows, numbered 1 to 20 without going backwards, each carrying exactly the 8 rates its printed header promises. That proves the SHAPE and not the digits, and it is weaker than arithmetic for exactly that reason. A REGULARITY, OFFERED AS A HYPOTHESIS AND NOT AS SOMETHING THE PAGE STATES: every rate reproduces as its own grade’s STEP 1 compounded at 3% and rounded to the cent -- round(step_1 x 1.03^(n-1)) -- in 140 of the 140 cells that are not a STEP 1. The page says nothing about 3%; what it says in words is only that `Employees receive a step increase each year until they reach the 8th Step`. So this is not the proof, and it is recorded because a single misread digit would break it and none does.
